This table replaces table 36-10-0402. Data in this table are not fully comparable with those previously published.
For the chained dollars, the aggregates are not equal to the sum of their components.

The chained dollars are not intended for use in analyzing shares or levels, as they do not represent the nominal structure of the economy or nominal gross domestic product (GDP). The chained dollars GDP estimates are based on the Fisher volume index and are useful for analyzing trends or growth rates. For share or level analysis, use current dollars GDP estimates, as they represent the nominal structure of the economy.

Contributions to percentage change (CPC) in real gross domestic product (GDP) show how much each industry contributed to the total percent increase or decrease in GDP of a province or territory's economy. These should not be interpreted as proportions of GDP. They are presented directly as a contribution in percentage points of the underlying components to the total economy. For additional information, please consult: Contributions to percent change (opens new window)."

With November 6, 2025 release, the provincial and territorial gross domestic product (GDP) by industry adopted the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Canada 2022 version 1.0 (opens new window)."

The alphanumeric code represents an aggregation of North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) industries, whose definition is available in the <a href=https://www.statcan.gc.ca/en/statistical-programs/document/1303_D7_V4" rel="external noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Gross domestic product (GDP) by industry
Industry 111CL covers only licensed cannabis producers in the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) codes 111412 and 111995.
Industry 111CU covers only unlicensed cannabis producers in the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) codes 111412 and 111995.
Industries in sector 23 are special hybrids that correspond to sections of the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code 23.
Industry 459BL covers only licensed cannabis retailers in the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code 459993.
Industry 459BU covers only unlicensed cannabis retailers in the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code 459993.

Statistical breaks were introduced for industry 5121 estimates in reference years 2014 and 2015 resulting from refinements to the provincial allocation process. Users are advised to use caution when examining growth rates.

Owner-occupied dwellings (industry 5311A) is defined as resident households who own the dwelling where they reside and who are considered for purpose of the National Accounts to receive an income in kind equivalent to the market rental value of their dwelling.
